def factor_volume_shock_price_corr_smoothed(df):
    """Smooth rolling volume-shock/return correlation to reduce noise."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    ret = df_copy['close'].pct_change()
    vol_mean_prev = df_copy['volume'].rolling(20, min_periods=20).mean().shift(1)
    vol_shock = df_copy['volume'] / vol_mean_prev.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    window = 20
    raw_corr = ret.rolling(window, min_periods=window).corr(vol_shock)
    corr = raw_corr.rolling(5, min_periods=1).mean()
    corr = corr.fillna(0.0)
    df_copy['factor_volume_shock_price_corr_smoothed'] = corr
    return df_copy['factor_volume_shock_price_corr_smoothed']
